body: Atoms have a compact nucleus surrounded by electrons. The number of protons in the nucleus defines the element. A neutral atom has as many electrons as protons. Changing the number of electrons changes its electric charge, giving an ion.
Atoms of the same element can have different numbers of neutrons. These forms are isotopes. For example, carbon-12 and carbon-13 each have six protons. They have six and seven neutrons, respectively.
